an7.74:1.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave arako nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo
an7.74:1.2: arakassa kho pana bhikkhave satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ
an7.74:1.3: arako satthā sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
an7.74:1.4: appakaṃ brāhmaṇa jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ
an7.74:2.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa tiṇagge ussāvabindu suriye uggacchante khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an7.74:2.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa ussāvabindūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ
an7.74:3.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa thullaphusitake deve vassante udakabubbulaṃ khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti
an7.74:3.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa udakabubbulupamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ
an7.74:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa udake daṇḍarāji khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti
an7.74:4.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa udake daṇḍarājupamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ …
an7.74:5.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa nadī pabbateyyā dūraṅgamā sīghasotā hārahārinī natthi so khaṇo vā layo vā muhutto vā yaṃ sā dharati athakho sā gacchate ca vattate ca sandate ca
an7.74:5.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa nadīpabbateyyūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ …
an7.74:6.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa balavā puriso jivhagge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saññūhitvā appakasireneva vameyya
an7.74:6.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa kheḷapiṇḍupamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ …
an7.74:7.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa divasasantatte ayokaṭāhe maṃsapesī pakkhittā khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti
an7.74:7.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa maṃsapesūpamaṃ manussānaṃ jīvitaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ …
an7.74:8.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa gāvī vajjhā āghātanaṃ nīyamānā yaññadeva pādaṃ uddharati santike vadhassa santike maraṇassa
an7.74:8.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa gāvīvajjhūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇanti.
an7.74:9.1: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā ahosi
an7.74:9.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ chalevābādhā ahesuṃ
an7.74:9.3: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jigacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo
an7.74:9.4: so hi nāma bhikkhave arako satthā evaṃdīghāyukesu manussesu evaṃciraṭṭhitikesu evaṃappābādhesu sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desessati
an7.74:9.5: appakaṃ brāhmaṇa jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇanti
an7.74:10.2: appakaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ mantāya phoṭṭhabbaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ natthi jātassa amaraṇanti
an7.74:10.3: etarahi bhikkhave yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo vā
an7.74:10.4: vassasataṃ kho pana bhikkhave jīvanto tīṇiyeva utusatāni jīvati
an7.74:10.5: utusataṃ hemantānaṃ utusataṃ gimhānaṃ utusataṃ vassānaṃ
an7.74:10.6: tīṇi kho pana bhikkhave utusatāni jīvanto dvādasayeva māsasatāni jīvati
an7.74:10.7: cattāri māsasatāni hemantānaṃ cattāri māsasatāni gimhānaṃ cattāri māsasatāni vassānaṃ
an7.74:10.8: dvādasa kho pana bhikkhave māsasatāni jīvanto catuvīsatiṃyeva aḍḍhamāsasatāni jīvati
an7.74:10.9: aṭṭhaḍḍhamāsasatāni hemantānaṃ aṭṭhaḍḍhamāsasatāni gimhānaṃ aṭṭhaḍḍhamāsasatāni vassānaṃ
an7.74:10.10: catuvīsatiṃ kho pana bhikkhave aḍḍhamāsasatāni jīvanto chattiṃsaṃyeva rattisahassāni jīvati
an7.74:10.11: dvādasa rattisahassāni hemantānaṃ dvādasa rattisahassāni gimhānaṃ dvādasa rattisahassāni vassānaṃ
an7.74:10.12: chattiṃsaṃ kho pana bhikkhave rattisahassāni jīvanto dvesattatiññeva bhattasahassāni bhuñjati
an7.74:10.13: catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni hemantānaṃ catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni gimhānaṃ catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni vassānaṃ saddhiṃ mātuthaññāya saddhiṃ bhattantarāyena
an7.74:11.1: tatrime bhattantarāyā kupitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati dukkhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati byādhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati uposathikopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati alābhakenapi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati
an7.74:11.2: iti kho bhikkhave mayā vassasatāyukassa manussassa āyupi saṅkhāto āyuppamāṇampi saṅkhātaṃ utūpi saṅkhātā saṃvaccharāpi saṅkhātā māsāpi saṅkhātā aḍḍhamāsāpi saṅkhātā rattīpi saṅkhātā divāpi saṅkhātā bhattāpi saṅkhātā bhattantarāyāpi saṅkhātā
an7.74:11.3: yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya
an7.74:11.4: kataṃ vo taṃ mayā etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
